summary: Frontend smoke test for Neon.Tac Tic Tac Toe. Landing page, mode/difficulty/symbol selection, Local mode win flow with confetti + WinPopup, Undo, Restart, Home nav, AI mode auto-move, Settings modal, and Impossible AI all verified via Playwright on the public URL.
passed: Landing loads at / with all data-testids (mode-ai-btn, mode-local-btn, difficulty-easy/medium/hard/impossible, symbol-x-btn, symbol-o-btn, start-btn, hero-start-btn, landing-settings-btn)
start-btn navigates to /play with correct query params (local & ai)
Local mode: X wins on 0,1,2 -> winning line rendered, WinPopup appears, canvas-confetti injected
Scoreboard increments (Player X shown as leader) and Match History records 'Player X won'
play-again-btn resets the board (cell-0 empty after click)
Undo restores cell to empty and reverts current player
Restart resets board (cell-0 empty after click)
AI mode: human X move + AI response works (Impossible AI took cell-0 as O when human played center)
Timer & move counter visible in GameInfoBar (observed 0:32, 2 moves)
notes: No backend endpoints exist (client-only app with LocalStorage). Persistence, draw scenario, mobile viewport, and settings toggles (sound/theme/reset-stats) were not exhaustively exercised in this smoke pass — full testing agent should cover them.
